purpose: Retrieve telemetry interpretation and bounded platform contracts for AutoTriager incident investigations.
boundaries: Knowledge context is not a root-cause label or an executable causal rule.
Current incident observations stay separate and retain incident/time scope.
No credentials, intervention settings, benchmark answers, or future recovery outcomes are ingested.
Static source matching does not prove the deployed version or observed execution.
Web sources were manually checked on reviewed_on; rebuilding does not revalidate their latest content.

chunks.title: Logical service and instance identity
chunks.text: service.name identifies a logical service; service.namespace disambiguates groups. service.instance.id distinguishes its running instances. Several replicas may share one service.name.
chunks.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
chunks.application_limit: Do not merge different namespaces or infer that two records came from the same replica from service.name alone.

chunks.title: Service version is a separate attribute
chunks.text: service.version describes the component version, and its format is not standardized. The logical service name alone does not identify the version.
chunks.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
chunks.application_limit: A source commit and a telemetry service-name match do not establish deployed-source equality.

chunks.title: Client, server, and internal spans
chunks.text: CLIENT spans describe outgoing requests; SERVER spans describe incoming request handling. INTERNAL spans describe work inside an application. Context propagation commonly makes a remote SERVER span a child of a CLIENT span; nested CLIENT spans are also possible.
chunks.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
chunks.application_limit: Separate the emitting service from the service being called. Span kinds describe execution roles, not fault responsibility.

chunks.title: Trace context and parent linkage
chunks.text: A span has its own SpanContext, a possible parent, timing, attributes, links, and status. SpanContext carries TraceId and SpanId. Links can connect spans across traces, separately from the parent relationship.
chunks.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
chunks.application_limit: Build parent edges from preserved IDs within a trace; a call chain is not a causal attribution chain.

chunks.title: Error and unset span status
chunks.text: Unset is the default span status. Error records an error in the operation; Ok records validated successful completion. Non-recording spans discard added data, and recording alone does not guarantee export to the backend.
chunks.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
chunks.application_limit: An ERROR span does not identify an initiating cause. Missing spans or attributes do not prove that the operation did not happen.

chunks.title: RPC method, outcome, and convention version
chunks.text: RPC spans describe remote calls with method and outcome information. Client-side duration can include retries. The current conventions distinguish errors occurring before a response from returned error status codes and document migration behavior for older instrumentation.
chunks.source_section: RPC client span; migration notice; error.type
chunks.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
chunks.application_limit: Interpret original field names under their producer's convention version; do not assume a timeout proves a server-side code failure.

chunks.title: Log timestamps and optional trace fields
chunks.text: Timestamp records when an event occurred; ObservedTimestamp records when collection observed it. TraceId and SpanId are optional correlation fields. Resource identifies the source entity; Body and Attributes carry event content.
chunks.source_section: Log and Event Record Definition; Trace Context Fields
chunks.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
chunks.application_limit: Keep event time distinct from collection time. Similar wording or nearby timestamps alone do not establish a shared request.

chunks.title: Error classification depends on the operation
chunks.text: An error code needs operation context: even HTTP 404 may be expected when checking existence. Current guidance says handled or retried errors should not mark an overall operation as failed when it completes gracefully.
chunks.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
chunks.application_limit: This development guidance is interpretation context, not a guarantee that historical instrumentation complied with it.

chunks.title: A derived claim needs a source trail
chunks.text: PROV-O distinguishes entities, activities, and agents. Derivation connects an entity to material used to construct it; qualified derivation can describe the producing activity in more detail.
chunks.scope: Telemetry interpretation across authorized services; apply the producer's actual convention version
chunks.application_limit: AutoTriager uses these ideas for traceable evidence. A citation proves source identity only after resolution; it does not by itself prove that a claim is supported.

chunks.title: Checkout HTTP entry and order request
chunks.text: The frontend accepts POST /api/checkout and delegates order placement to CheckoutGateway.placeOrder. Other HTTP methods receive 405. On success it enriches returned order items with product details before replying.
chunks.scope: Official Shop source at the pinned commit; deployed-version equality and execution require incident evidence
chunks.application_limit: Static source context is not proof that this path executed or caused a particular incident.

chunks.title: Frontend classification of checkout errors
chunks.text: A failed PlaceOrder marks the frontend span ERROR. Its response mapping treats a charge-failure prefix without Unavailable or Internal as HTTP 422; other caught order-placement failures become HTTP 500. This is message-based classification, not independent cause verification.

chunks.title: Money representation and cross-field constraints
chunks.text: Money carries a currency code, integer units, and nanos in billionths of a unit. Nanos is bounded from -999999999 to 999999999. Positive units require nonnegative nanos; negative units require nonpositive nanos; zero units allow either sign.
